purpose: Does windowed PBT set up to adapt quickly (start over 1e-5-3.5e-4, bounds to 5e-4, x0.5/x2 mutations, two-epoch windows) match the best fixed learning rate? Validation-selected checkpoints of the fast PBT run and of the top fixed-LR grid (8e-5-3.2e-4) on the frozen Stage 2A holdout, paired with the ceiling-grid (3-8e-5) and original windowed-PBT checkpoints, which are re-evaluated as references. Primary comparison, fixed before training: fast PBT against whichever of the two fixed-LR checkpoints (ceiling grid, top grid) has the better validation metric.
